name: Logo Bar / Trust Bar
summary: Native ordered mark collection with a static default and an optional canonical Marquee presentation for bounded logical motion and persistent playback control.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Generic root, or labelled section when a visible contextual label exists; omitted when no valid marks exist.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual label. Its final heading rank is selected by the surrounding target document.

anatomy.name: viewport
anatomy.description: Canonical Marquee viewport; it clips only after a valid marquee enhancement.

anatomy.name: sourceList
anatomy.description: The one authoritative native list of target-owned marks in meaningful source order; it also carries the canonical Marquee source-group class.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item containing one informative, decorative or functional target-owned mark composition.

anatomy.name: mark
anatomy.description: Target-supplied raster image, SVG or equivalent mark with explicit alternative-text intent.

anatomy.name: destination
anatomy.description: Native anchor used only when a real destination exists and the mark names that purpose.

anatomy.name: visualCopy
anatomy.description: At most one canonical Marquee visual copy, aria-hidden, inert, non-interactive and absent from the semantic data source.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Canonical compact Button, additionally identified by the Logo Bar part class in adapters, revealed only for a valid marquee enhancement and labelled with the next Pause or Resume action.

variants.name: static
variants.description: Default intrinsic wrapping collection with no visual copy, playback control or component runtime work.

variants.name: marquee
variants.description: Explicitly composes canonical Marquee Auto behavior while preserving the same authoritative mark list.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One container-responsive presentation; mark box, gap and wrapping geometry remain private.

states.name: static
states.description: The authoritative mark list wraps intrinsically and no playback control exists.

states.name: pending
states.description: No-JavaScript and pre-enhancement marquee markup stays readable and static.

states.name: playing
states.description: Canonical Marquee CSS motion runs at the measured duration for the selected semantic pace.

states.name: temporarilyPaused
states.description: Pointer presence temporarily suspends marquee motion without changing the durable user preference.

states.name: userPaused
states.description: Focus entry or Pause activation creates a durable pause until explicit Resume.

states.name: linkedMarkFocusVisible
states.description: The authoritative native mark link has a visible keyboard focus indicator.

states.name: reducedMotion
states.description: The source list is static, the visual copy is hidden and the playback control is omitted.

behavior.name: nativeMarkCollection
behavior.description: Targets supply one ordered native list. Informative marks name the represented entity, decorative marks are hidden, and linked marks use a native anchor only for a real destination.

behavior.name: canonicalMarqueeComposition
behavior.description: Marquee presentation delegates duplication, measurement, logical direction, semantic pace, playback, focus, visibility and reduced-motion behavior to canonical S18 without a second state owner.

behavior.name: progressiveFallback
behavior.description: Empty collections omit the root. Static, reduced-motion, missing-JavaScript, failed-enhancement and one-item output stays readable with no usable motion control.

behavior.name: boundedLinkedCopies
behavior.description: Generated linked marks are aria-hidden, inert, pointer-inactive and removed from focus navigation; only the authoritative link remains interactive.

behavior.name: stateOwnership
behavior.description: Neutral Web marquee playback is uncontrolled for the live component lifetime. Framework targets may project controlled state around the same owner, not add a second state machine.

properties.name: presentation
properties.description: Static wrapping collection or explicit canonical Marquee presentation.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional visible contextual label; blank omits both the label and section landmark.

properties.name: marks
properties.description: One ordered native list of target-owned informative, decorative or functional mark compositions; the root is omitted when empty.

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Marquee-only logical direction independent of physical left/right.

properties.name: pace
properties.description: Marquee-only semantic distance-normalized velocity preset; raw duration remains private.

properties.name: pauseLabel
properties.description: Localized visible next-action label required for the canonical Button when marquee motion can be paused.

properties.name: resumeLabel
properties.description: Localized visible next-action label used while marquee motion is durably paused.

accessibility: Preserve one authoritative native list in meaningful target-authored order; classify every mark as informative, decorative or functional and never infer truthful alternative text from a filename.
Use native anchors only for real destinations, give each functional mark a useful accessible name, preserve visible focus and keep every generated linked copy inert and unfocusable.
Do not use Logo Bar as the only location for critical policy, price, availability, status, deadline, instruction or error information.
For marquee presentation, expose one localized canonical Button for persistent Pause and Resume, pause durably on focus entry, pause temporarily on hover and suspend while the document is hidden.
Render a readable static list and omit the playback control for static, reduced motion, missing JavaScript, failed enhancement, invalid content or one item.
Preserve logical source order, RTL direction, forced colors, localization, narrow containers and 200 percent text zoom without horizontal page overflow or clipped focus.

web.notes: Canonical Logo Bar CSS composes canonical Marquee markup, runtime and Button control without a second motion owner.

shopify.notes: Map ordered image/link blocks, explicit alternative text and static/marquee settings to the same source semantics; editor-preview runtime remains target certification work.
